text:
sophie: Heads up — docs build failing on main CI: anchor resolution error plus MDX code-sample indentation causing the following heading to be swallowed. Seen on both mkdocs and docusaurus. cc @matt @jordan

matt: Thanks. Can you paste the failing log and a minimal mdx example that reproduces it?

sophie: Pasted log + minimal file below. Repro steps: `yarn docs:build` on main.
```
ERROR: AnchorResolutionError: unable to find fragment for #usage
  at resolveAnchor (linkcheck.js:45)
  at Object.<anonymous> (build.js:112)
  ...
```
Minimal MDX (broken render):
```mdx
# API
Some intro paragraph.
```js
console.log('example')
```
## Usage
Explain how to use it.
```
When rendered the `## Usage` becomes nested and its anchor is not generated (anchor attached to code block).

jordan: This looks like an MDX/remark/rehype interaction — maybe a sanitizer or prettier-mdx rule removed the blank line between the fenced code block and the heading, which makes the parser treat the heading as part of the code fence in the rendered AST.

sophie: We recently enabled `prettier-mdx` in the docs repo (#2430) and added a commit hook. It normalizes fences and sometimes removes the extra newline. I suspect that normalization combined with our slug plugin caused the anchor to attach incorrectly.

akash: I can whip up a targeted fix: add a lint rule that enforces a blank line after fenced code blocks when the next block is a heading. Quick patch in `docs/tools/mdx-lint.js` to check for `fence -> heading` sequences. Also propose pinning `remark`/`rehype` versions used in CI.

matt: For a short-term hotfix we could post-process the generated HTML to relocate headings that are direct children of `pre`/`code`. Ugly but will unblock the build. Long-term let's fix the source MDX transform and linter.

docs-bot: preview build: PR #2461 failed — anchor-resolve error (ci/docs)

sophie: I'll open a hotfix PR that adds both: (1) a pre-commit/CI `mdx-snippet-lint` rule that enforces the blank line, and (2) a sanitizer that strips invisible bidi/formatting marks from headings (U+200F etc.) since some external snippets include them and they break slug generation. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2463

matt: Great. Please include unit tests in `tests/docs/fixtures` with a small mdx file that used to fail. Add a short note in the migration guide about `prettier-mdx` behavior and the new CI guard. Also add `mdx-snippet-lint` to the docs CI job so merges are blocked until fixed.

jordan: I'll add a small sanitizer in the build pipeline that runs `string.replace(/[‎‏‪-‮]/g, '')` on heading text before slugify. That should stop invisible marks from changing anchors.

sophie: PR is up as a draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2463 — contains: blank-line linter, bidi sanitizer, tests. Marking ready after CI passes. :party_parrot:

matt: Nice. Once CI passes ping #eng-docs and I'll review + merge. Also add a changelog entry so we remember the linter addition.

docs-bot: preview build passed for PR #2463 — staging preview at https://deploy-preview-2463--docs.redwood.ai/

sophie: Thanks everyone — merging once we have reviews. Will follow up with backport to the `release` branch if needed.
